gloss: to wipe off; to wipe away

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {拭|ぬぐ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to wipe off; to wipe away
definitions.explanation: To remove liquid, dirt, or something unwanted by wiping with a cloth or hand.
Figuratively, to eliminate or remove something negative like doubts or suspicions.

examples.english: I wiped off the sweat with a towel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ぬぐ}って⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: She wiped away her tears and showed a smile.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疑惑|ぎわく}→疑惑：13602_giwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ぬぐ}えない。
⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ぬぐ}い{去|さ}ること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。

⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ぬぐ}い{去|さ}ること⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how many times I heard the explanation, I couldn't dispel my doubts.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ぬぐ}う

ASPECT (ている):
{拭|ぬぐ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ - is wiping (action in progress)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ぬぐ}う - to wipe off sweat
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ぬぐ}う - to wipe away tears
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ぬぐ}う - to wipe one's mouth

USAGE:
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ぬぐ}う - to dispel anxiety
- ⟦{疑惑|ぎわく}→疑惑：13602_giwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ぬぐ}う - to clear away suspicions
- ⟦{汚名|おめい}→汚名：13265_omei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拭|ぬぐ}う - to clear one's name
{拭|ぬぐ}う is slightly more literary/formal than ⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧ - to wipe (more common, everyday)
- {拭|ぬぐ}い{去|さ}る - to wipe away completely
